cultivar: Huaqiu No. 1 and other suitable local cultivars
processing: Dark tea made from small- and medium-leaf cultivars, whose lower polyphenol content gives a gentler cup. Production follows a local Qionglai technical standard for dark tea.
harvest_season: No prized picking is widely described; as with other Sichuan dark teas, the raw material is generally more mature than for fine green tea.
taste_profile: Clean aroma and a mellow, gentle taste without much astringency.

brewing.notes: Boiling water, as with other dark teas. A short rinse is common. Compressed pieces can also be simmered.

vintage_note: Sold under its protected geographical name, with the producer and production year on the pack. As is usual for dark tea it is not a current-season product and can be stored, but little is recorded about how particular years develop. Check for the geographical indication mark.
description:
Qionglai Heicha is the dark tea of Qionglai city in Sichuan, a protected geographical name rather than a single recipe. Its distinct point is the leaf: small- and medium-leaf cultivars, not the big-leaf material of Yunnan.

That leaf is lower in polyphenols and catechins, which explains the soft cup. The protected area covers 16 towns and townships across Qionglai, and production has a local technical standard behind it.

Dry leaf should be black-brown and the liquor orange-yellow, with a clean smell and a mellow taste. Specific steep-by-steep notes are scarce, so treat it like other Sichuan dark teas: boiling water, a rinse and medium steeps.

Grade names such as jin jian appear in local descriptions, and they overlap with other Sichuan border-tea terms. Ask which product you are actually buying, and look for the protected origin mark.
history:
China's former quality inspection authority approved Qionglai Heicha as a protected geographical indication product in February 2015. The Qionglai government had requested the protected zone in 2014, and a local production standard dates from the same year.

The older story of dark tea in this district is much less clearly recorded than the modern protection.
